concept.hook: The Dou Di battleground was dissolving — but the Flame Emperor's final command echoed through the realm. Deep beneath the battleground, something ancient stirred. The Flame Sect's last guardian had been waiting three thousand years for this moment.

audio.narration: The Dou Di battleground had served its purpose. Three thousand years of spirits, judges, and ancient power — all held in stasis, waiting for the Flame Emperor's heir to arrive. Now that he had, the realm was folding back into the earth. The Flame Sect alarm bell. Not heard since the night of the betrayal. Every member of the Flame Sect knew that sound — it meant the sect was in mortal danger. Or that its master had returned. The Flame Sect's last guardian. He had been buried beneath the battleground since the night of the betrayal — placed there by the Flame Emperor himself, with one purpose: to wait for the heir. Three thousand years of stone. Three thousand years of patience. And now — finally — he had arrived. Three thousand years. He had slept beneath the earth for three thousand years — alone, patient, faithful — waiting for a signet he had never been sure would return. And now the young master stood before him, wearing the Flame Emperor's mark. The greatest warrior the Flame Sect had ever produced was now Xiao Yan's sword. Not because he had to be — but because he chose to be. Three thousand years of loyalty, finally fulfilled.
